title: scolymocephalus laevis
intro: Scolymocephalus laevis, commonly known as Scolymus hispidus, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Scolymocephalus laevis include its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
